Howdy!
	I am currently helping out in the maintainence of Maclisp on
Oz.  GSB is, I believe, considered in charge.  The canonical sources
currently live on MC, but should be moved to Oz eventually.  I agree
with GJC, Maclisp should remain stable right now.  Make an XLISP, and
use that.  Apparently BBLISP.EXE and LISP.EXE are two very special
files, and updating them can really break the world (as I found out
the hard way).  Perhaps this discussion should move off of Bug-Lisp
and onto a local Oz mailing list of some sort.  

						--Chiron
